1. Screened all 40 individual features, finding feature 0 (Sharpe 0.557) and feature 39 (0.551) as top standalone performers, with feature 38 also showing strong signal when sign-flipped (-0.569 → 0.569 flipped).

I discounted substantially from the in-sample 0.966 because:
- The search involved ~150 evaluations, creating meaningful risk of overfitting to in-sample noise (multiple comparisons problem)
- Combining 3 features found via greedy search on the same dataset compounds this risk
- Daily-frequency financial Sharpe ratios typically show significant in-sample/out-of-sample degradation
- The wide standard deviation (0.35) reflects genuine uncertainty about how much of the 0.966 signal is real structure vs. sampling noise, while still centering above zero given that features 0 and 39 individually showed consistent, sizable standalone Sharpes suggesting genuine (not purely spurious) signal.
